title: acalypha stipularis
intro: Acalypha stipularis, commonly known as the Red Stalked Acalypha, is a plant species in the family Euphorbiaceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as treating fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Acalypha stipularis include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which help to soothe and protect the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and tannins, which are responsible for its medicinal and therapeutic effects.
